title.en: A public officer asked me for a bribe

summary.en: You were asked to pay for a government service that should be free, or asked to pay extra to get it faster. The Independent Corrupt Practices and Other Related Offences Commission (ICPC) investigates this. You can report by phone, online, by post, or in person, and even an oral or illiterate complaint must be written down for you by an ICPC officer.

rights.en: Anyone, anywhere in the world, can file a complaint against a person or organisation in Nigeria where there are reasonable grounds to suspect a corrupt practices offence.
You do not need to write your complaint yourself. If you report orally, or cannot read or write, an ICPC officer must write it down and read it back to you.

evidence.en: Where and when it happened, and which office or service was involved.
The name, rank or office of the officer if you know it. You can still report without it.
How much was demanded, and whether you paid.
Any receipt, message, photo or recording. Do not put yourself at risk to collect evidence.

action.en: Write down what happened while it is fresh

detail.en: Date, time, place, office, officer, amount. This is what your petition will need.
Online through ICPC's petition portal, by phone, by post, or in person at any ICPC office nationwide.

action.en: Keep a record of your petition

detail.en: Note the date you submitted it and who you spoke to or corresponded with, so you can follow up.

institutions.name: Independent Corrupt Practices and Other Related Offences Commission (ICPC)

role.en: Nigeria's apex body for investigating and prosecuting corruption and bribery in the public and private sectors.

mandate.en: Established in 2000 under the Corrupt Practices and Other Related Offences Act. Receives and investigates reports of corruption, and educates the public on corruption and related offences.

title.en: I, or someone I know, was wrongly arrested or imprisoned and cannot afford a lawyer
title.sw: Mimi, au mtu ninayemjua, nimekamatwa au kufungwa kimakosa na sina uwezo wa kulipia wakili
title.fr: Moi, ou quelqu'un que je connais, avons été arrêté ou emprisonné à tort et n'avons pas les moyens de payer un avocat

summary.en: An arrest, charge, or conviction feels wrong, or someone is being held without a lawyer or without being brought to court properly. Free legal aid exists in Nigeria for exactly this. This can be filed by the person affected, or by someone filing on their behalf if they cannot reach a phone or the internet themselves — including someone currently in custody.
summary.sw: Kukamatwa, mashtaka, au hukumu inaonekana si sahihi, au mtu anazuiliwa bila wakili au bila kupelekwa mahakamani ipasavyo. Msaada wa kisheria wa bure upo Nigeria kwa hali kama hii. Hii inaweza kuwasilishwa na mhusika mwenyewe, au na mtu mwingine kwa niaba yake ikiwa hawezi kufikia simu au mtandao mwenyewe — ikiwemo mtu aliye kizuizini kwa sasa.
summary.fr: Une arrestation, une inculpation ou une condamnation vous semble injuste, ou une personne est détenue sans avocat ou sans avoir été présentée correctement devant un tribunal. Une aide juridique gratuite existe au Nigéria précisément pour cela. Ce signalement peut être déposé par la personne concernée, ou par quelqu'un en son nom si elle ne peut pas elle-même accéder à un téléphone ou à internet — y compris une personne actuellement détenue.

rights.en: Section 35 of the Constitution entitles every person to personal liberty and strictly limits the grounds on which anyone may be deprived of it.
rights.sw: Kifungu cha 35 cha Katiba kinampa kila mtu haki ya uhuru wa kibinafsi na kinaweka mipaka mikali kuhusu sababu za kumnyima mtu uhuru huo.
rights.fr: L'article 35 de la Constitution garantit à toute personne le droit à la liberté individuelle et limite strictement les motifs pour lesquels elle peut en être privée.

rights.en: Section 36 guarantees a fair hearing within a reasonable time before an independent and impartial court or tribunal.
rights.sw: Kifungu cha 36 kinahakikisha usikilizwaji wa haki ndani ya muda unaofaa mbele ya mahakama huru na isiyo na upendeleo.
rights.fr: L'article 36 garantit une audience équitable dans un délai raisonnable devant un tribunal indépendant et impartial.

rights.en: The Legal Aid Act, 2011 entitles anyone who cannot afford a lawyer to apply to the Legal Aid Council for free legal representation, including in criminal matters.
rights.sw: Sheria ya Msaada wa Kisheria, 2011 inampa haki mtu yeyote asiyeweza kumudu wakili kuomba uwakilishi wa bure wa kisheria kutoka Baraza la Msaada wa Kisheria, ikiwemo mashauri ya jinai.
rights.fr: La loi de 2011 sur l'aide juridique donne à toute personne n'ayant pas les moyens de payer un avocat le droit de demander une représentation juridique gratuite au Conseil de l'aide juridique, y compris dans les affaires pénales.

evidence.en: The court case number, the court's name, and the date of arrest, charge, or sentencing.
evidence.sw: Namba ya kesi mahakamani, jina la mahakama, na tarehe ya kukamatwa, mashtaka, au hukumu.
evidence.fr: Le numéro de l'affaire, le nom du tribunal, et la date de l'arrestation, de l'inculpation ou de la condamnation.

evidence.en: Which prison or police station is holding the person now, if known.
evidence.sw: Ni gereza au kituo gani cha polisi kinamzuia mtu huyo sasa, kama inajulikana.
evidence.fr: Le lieu de détention actuel de la personne — prison ou poste de police — si connu.

evidence.en: What stage the case is at: awaiting trial, convicted and not yet appealed, or an appeal already filed.
evidence.sw: Kesi iko hatua gani: inasubiri kesi, imehukumiwa lakini bado haijakatiwa rufaa, au rufaa tayari imewasilishwa.
evidence.fr: L'état actuel de l'affaire : en attente de procès, condamnée sans appel déposé, ou appel déjà déposé.

action.en: Write down the case number, court, and key dates now
action.sw: Andika namba ya kesi, mahakama, na tarehe muhimu sasa
action.fr: Notez dès maintenant le numéro de l'affaire, le tribunal et les dates clés

detail.en: Every legal aid provider will ask for these first.
detail.sw: Kila mtoa msaada wa kisheria atauliza hivi kwanza.
detail.fr: Tout prestataire d'aide juridique demandera cela en premier.

action.en: Contact the Legal Aid Council of Nigeria (LACON)
action.sw: Wasiliana na Baraza la Msaada wa Kisheria la Nigeria (LACON)
action.fr: Contactez le Conseil de l'aide juridique du Nigéria (LACON)

detail.en: LACON is the federal body created to provide free legal aid and representation, including for indigent persons facing criminal charges or already convicted, through its Call-in Centre and state offices.
detail.sw: LACON ni taasisi ya shirikisho iliyoanzishwa kutoa msaada wa bure wa kisheria na uwakilishi, ikiwemo kwa watu wasio na uwezo wanaokabiliwa na mashtaka ya jinai au walioshahukumiwa, kupitia Kituo chake cha Simu na ofisi za majimbo.
detail.fr: LACON est l'organisme fédéral créé pour fournir une aide juridique et une représentation gratuites, y compris aux personnes indigentes faisant face à des accusations pénales ou déjà condamnées, via son centre d'appel et ses bureaux d'État.

role.en: The federal agency that provides free legal advice, assistance, and representation to indigent Nigerians, including in criminal appeals, through offices across the states.
role.sw: Taasisi ya shirikisho inayotoa ushauri wa bure wa kisheria, msaada, na uwakilishi kwa Wanigeria wasio na uwezo, ikiwemo katika rufaa za jinai, kupitia ofisi kote majimboni.
role.fr: L'organisme fédéral qui fournit conseils juridiques, assistance et représentation gratuits aux Nigérians indigents, y compris pour les appels pénaux, via des bureaux répartis dans les États.

mandate.en: Established under the Legal Aid Act, 2011.
mandate.sw: Ilianzishwa chini ya Sheria ya Msaada wa Kisheria, 2011.
mandate.fr: Créé en vertu de la loi de 2011 sur l'aide juridique.

note.en: LACON's published Call-in Centre line, from its own official contact page.
note.sw: Namba ya Kituo cha Simu cha LACON iliyotangazwa, kutoka ukurasa wake rasmi wa mawasiliano.
note.fr: La ligne du centre d'appel de LACON, publiée sur sa propre page de contact officielle.

note.en: General enquiries email, published on LACON's own site.
note.sw: Barua pepe ya maswali ya jumla, iliyochapishwa kwenye tovuti ya LACON.
note.fr: Adresse e-mail pour demandes générales, publiée sur le site de LACON.

note.en: LACON's site lists state office contacts across Nigeria.
note.sw: Tovuti ya LACON inaorodhesha mawasiliano ya ofisi za majimbo kote Nigeria.
note.fr: Le site de LACON répertorie les contacts des bureaux d'État à travers le Nigéria.

timeline.en: Contacting LACON's Call-in Centre takes minutes. Being assigned a lawyer and getting an appeal filed can take longer depending on caseloads and the state office involved — ask about any appeal deadline the moment you speak to someone.
timeline.sw: Kuwasiliana na Kituo cha Simu cha LACON huchukua dakika. Kupangiwa wakili na kuwasilisha rufaa kunaweza kuchukua muda mrefu zaidi kutegemea idadi ya kesi na ofisi ya jimbo inayohusika — uliza kuhusu muda wowote wa mwisho wa rufaa mara tu unapozungumza na mtu.
timeline.fr: Contacter le centre d'appel de LACON prend quelques minutes. L'attribution d'un avocat et le dépôt d'un appel peuvent prendre plus de temps selon la charge de travail et le bureau d'État concerné — renseignez-vous sur tout délai d'appel dès que vous parlez à quelqu'un.
